launchComparisons.impactRationale: This is a direct premium-UHPLC workflow and user-experience challenge. The official launch confirms stronger built-in assistance, automation, sample tracking, predictive feedback, and method compatibility, but it does not demonstrate that ACQUITY Premier is technically inferior.
launchComparisons.pmRead: Agilent is competing on the daily LC experience—not only chromatographic specifications. InfinityLab Assist automates instrument routines, supports sample preparation, provides maintenance and troubleshooting guidance, and adds barcode/camera sample tracking. This raises the proof standard for ACQUITY Premier's operational simplicity, but the public evidence does not establish an Agilent performance lead.
launchComparisons.watersPositioning: Position ACQUITY Premier where MaxPeak HPS creates measurable recovery, peak-shape, reproducibility, and passivation-time benefits for metal-sensitive analytes. Pair that scientific advantage with quantified proof for setup time, operator steps, system readiness, method transfer, and troubleshooting so Agilent does not own the ease-of-use narrative.
launchComparisons.evidenceBasis: Agilent's official October 2024 release supports the automation, assistance, sample-tracking, compatibility, and sustainability claims. Waters' official ACQUITY Premier page supports MaxPeak HPS, metal-sensitive-analyte recovery, reduced passivation, repeatability, and LC-MS workflow claims. No common-condition head-to-head test is loaded.

dimensions.waters: ACQUITY Premier's sourced differentiation is scientific: inert MaxPeak HPS flow path, reduced adsorption, faster readiness, and improved results for metal-sensitive analytes.
dimensions.pmRead: Waters needs operational proof alongside the existing scientific differentiation.
